The hold was framed as Groß-or-Barcola when it never had to be: Groß has started and played every minute of all five games, with 3 goals and 4 assists including a goal and a corner assist in Brighton's 3-0 win over Arsenal. 47 points, unowned, is the single biggest thing on this board and has sat there a month.
